text.description: Plain text or SSML (wrapped in <speak>...</speak>) to synthesize

output_path.description: Absolute or relative path where the audio file will be saved

voice.description: Google Cloud TTS voice name, e.g. 'en-US-Neural2-A' or 'de-DE-Neural2-F'

language_code.description: BCP-47 language code matching the voice, e.g. 'en-US' or 'de-DE'
